summary: Targeted retest of the 3 defects from iteration_1 (JD empty core fields, wildcard CORS with credentials, missing brute-force lockout). Created /app/backend/tests/test_retest_fixes.py (7 tests) + probe script. All 7 tests PASSED. Additionally verified playbook items: bcrypt hash format ($2b$12$, 60 chars), httpOnly access_token cookie on login, seed_admin idempotency/password-update logic, and success-clears-lockout-counter behaviour. DB login_attempts cleaned and cleanup_test_data.py run afterwards.

minor.issue: Cloudflare edge still rewrites access-control-allow-origin to '*' while access-control-allow-credentials stays 'true' (invalid combo for credentialed browser requests). App-level headers at http://localhost:8001 are correct (origin echoed + vary: Origin). Not fixable in app code; only impacts cookie-based cross-origin calls — frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage, so no functional break today.

critical_code_review_comments: Lockout key is ip:email; behind the k8s ingress all traffic may share one client IP, so a single attacker email cannot lock others out (good), but an attacker rotating emails is unthrottled. Consider an additional per-IP counter if abuse protection matters.
login_attempts documents are never TTL-expired; add a TTL index on 'at' (e.g. 30 min) so the collection does not grow unbounded.
CORS_ORIGINS="*" falls back to allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — functionally permissive. For production, set explicit origins.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Transient bruteforce.retest+<uuid>@example.com login_attempts records were created and deleted; JD generations were not saved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified evidence: (1) POST /api/jd/generate returns non-empty job_summary/responsibilities/required_skills/preferred_skills/qualifications/experience/reporting_structure with default include_sections AND with include_sections=['Company Overview'] (in the latter case kpis/benefits/career_growth/diversity_statement are correctly empty and company_overview populated). (2) Internal backend echoes Origin, access-control-allow-credentials: true, vary: Origin on both OPTIONS preflight and POST; public URL shows '*' due to Cloudflare edge only. (3) 5 wrong logins => 401 each, 6th => 429 'Too many failed attempts. Try again later.'; a successful login clears the counter. Always clear db.login_attempts before rerunning lockout tests (window is 15 min).
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_1 root causes were all fixed: ai_service.generate_job_description now gates ONLY the 5 optional sections via include_sections and instructs the model to always populate core fields; server.py uses allow_origin_regex when CORS_ORIGINS is '*'/empty so Starlette echoes the request Origin with credentials; routes_auth.login records failures in db.login_attempts keyed by ip:email and raises 429 after 5 failures within 15 minutes, deleting failures on successful auth.
